highlights: , I was trying not to get invested in this year’s Tony Awards race for best actress in a musical, knowing that all the nominees were hugely deserving. (Fortunately, I live in Los Angeles, so when I explained I was happy over a Tony win, they understood all too well and ... That message was a direct reference to the skepticism Scherzinger faced at the start. When it was first announced in 2023 that Scherzinger would be starring as faded screen star Norma Desmond in a revival of “ Sunset Boulevard,” it was not a sure thing that her journey was going to end onstage in one of the most competitive Tony Awards races in history. The role had previously received rave reviews and accolades for the likes of Gloria Swanson, Glenn Close and Patti LuPone. Many were skeptical about the former Pussycat Doll, whose biggest film credit to that point was as playing the leather-clad girlfriend to an alien in “Men In Black 3,” following in such impressive shoes. So perhaps it’s fitting that she did it barefoot, in a stripped-down production that found her onstage in only a black slip dress without the painted makeup and turban generally associated with the character.  By now, most people are aware that Scherzinger’s performance is a triumph, that Jamie Lloyd’s production reimagined and reinvigorated the Andrew Lloyd Webber musical and that the unconventional casting paid off. Consider this: the star-making performance by Helen J. Shen, the lead actress in best musical winner “Maybe Happy Ending,” failed to make the cut.
